assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for underlying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The ordered 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is clinically indicated.
This service directly addresses the need to capture potential arrhythmic events as described in the clinical indication note.
